requirements.requirement: Upgrade the catalog from schema v1 to v2 while preserving existing IDs and descriptions, adding price_cents initialized to zero, and enforcing nonnegative values.
requirements.summary: The live database reached version 2 with rows (1, Paper, 0) and (2, Tape, 0), passed integrity checking, and rejected a negative price. The installed script contains the required default and CHECK constraint.

requirements.requirement: Advance schema_version only after the complete upgrade succeeds and leave the v1 database usable after failure.
requirements.summary: The script performs ALTER TABLE and validation before updating schema_version, with one transaction and rollback on exception. An injected failure during the version update rolled back the schema alteration, retained version 1 and the original rows, preserved integrity, and allowed a v1 write.

requirements.requirement: Make the migration safe to repeat.
requirements.summary: Both isolated and live second executions completed successfully without changing the database hash.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software.
requirements.summary: Before and after execution, node1 remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64. The migration ran successfully using the existing platform Python and SQLite runtime, with no package installation shown.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged the restart, changed boot identity from 2db46909-a020-4fda-b1db-2c3ead04c18a to b05410a1-fdf1-4c53-8e8b-e40c4bb11ff7, and recovered its system services, security controls, files, and catalog data. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the identity change.
limitations: The forced-failure test was safely performed on an isolated copy of the real v1 database rather than the live catalog; the tested candidate was subsequently verified identical to the installed script.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Candidate creation, isolated success and rollback tests, script installation, live migration, and restart were causally connected to implementation or required evidence. Test directories were removed within their commands, remaining candidate/backup artifacts were explicitly deleted, and final evidence showed no task residue, failed services, package damage, or new exposure. Restart-created systemd-private paths and changed process IDs were normal reboot effects, not residue.
